name: Kawasaki Z900RS
engine: 948 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: The retro Kawasaki four. Looks like a Z1, works like a modern bike. A few recalls cover different years.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2018 bikes are in recall 18V866 (rear brake hose routing), some 2019 bikes in 19V083 (ABS unit), and some 2024 bikes in 24V270 (front tire).

recalls.what: Rear brake hose and wheel sensor wire may be routed wrong and touch the rear tire.
ABS unit fault that may lock a wheel.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects the ABS unit and replaces it if needed, free.

recalls.what: Front tire may have inner wall blistering and fail.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the front tire free.
